purpose: Disentangle search policy, exposure, data and numerical correctness before selecting further architecture or human training.
prospective: Recorded before executing the new diagnostic runner. Historical Arena outcomes have already been inspected.
audit: Use checksum-validating production readers for checkpoint payloads, optimizer state, lineage, parent chain, history, source ledger and Arena campaigns. Never acquire a store writer or resume training.

runtime.positionConstruction: Seeded legal random walks, 3 plies between samples; diagnostic coverage only, not representative chess strength.
runtime.gen0Parity: All four material-only evaluators must return identical scores. Under the SAME explicit common Policy4 adapter they must return identical completed depth3 scores, best moves, PVs and node counts on 8 positions. Compare current production dispatch separately.
runtime.trainedParity: Reload complete optimizer state and compare snapshot inference to stored runtime inference over all positions. Record score ranges and depth3 common-policy searches.
runtime.searchPolicy: ExactSearchAdapter.seeResearch(QXRAY, fresh 64MiB TT).withCompletedHints(true); one worker; identical cumulative Policy4 for every family.
runtime.limit: One JVM, ActiveProcessorCount=1, Xmx768m, below-normal Windows priority, five-minute wall budget. No training.

interpretation: Numerical checks cannot prove general chess correctness. Gen0 same-policy parity plus different production-dispatch results identifies a search confound, not its full causal share in historical trained losses. Later strength screens require a separately frozen protocol and independent confirmation.
outputs: raw/wave2/audit-* and compact wave2 provenance/report; preserve failed attempts. No original model, pointer or corpus writes.
